project_info.theme: Modern elegance urban cafe magazine cover
project_info.color_palette: black, warm gold, rich brown, cream and natural skin tones

main_subject.detail: Adult woman with voluminous slightly messy hair and a soft intense gaze wears a minimalist black blazer in a softly blurred urban cafe.
main_subject.style: ultra-realistic cinematic fashion editorial with natural skin texture

composition_elements.layout: clean centered 4:5 portrait cover with face sharp and creamy cafe bokeh
composition_elements.text: FASHION at top, NEW SEASON NEW YOU at right, MODERN ELEGANCE at bottom, approved editorial quotes and barcode.

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: soft directional golden-hour key at 4300K with warm rim light and subtle cafe fill
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: natural face glow, rich skin tones, soft highlights and premium depth

technical_specs.render_style: Canon EOS R5, RF 85mm f/1.2L, cinematic magazine cover photography
technical_specs.optics: sharp face, shallow depth of field and subtle film grain

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an ultra-realistic cinematic fashion magazine cover featuring an approved adult woman, preserving her face, skin tone, hair texture and natural appearance when an authorized reference is attached. She wears a modern elegant black minimalist blazer and poses confidently with a soft intense gaze toward camera. Use warm golden-hour directional light on face and hair, a softly blurred urban cafe background, rich natural skin tones, clean centered portrait framing, 4:5 ratio, sharp face and creamy bokeh. Add a high-end magazine typography layout with large serif FASHION at top, small subtitle near top, NEW SEASON NEW YOU on the right, MODERN ELEGANCE at bottom, minimal editorial quote blocks and a barcode. Use generic or licensed magazine branding only, not Vogue without authorization. Render 8K premium fashion editorial photography.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, celebrity likeness without authorization, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, illegible cover text, invented logo, barcode distortion
